Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 24-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Delhi Research Associate - III Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to send the application via email for NIT Delhi Research Associate - III recruitment is 24 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Associate - III at NIT Delhi?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Research Associate - III post in the National Institute of Technology Delhi recruitment drive. Interested candidates should apply promptly.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NIT Delhi Research Associate - III posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Research Associate - III position at NIT Delhi is via Email. Candidates need to send their complete application to the official email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Research Associate - III post at NIT Delhi?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate - III post will receive a salary of Rs. 67,000 + 30% HRA per month. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for Research Associate - III?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Ph.D. or equivalent degree in Environmental Science/Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or relevant areas with minimum 60% marks, or 3 years of experience after M.E./M.Tech./M.V.Sc. with a research paper.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for NIT Delhi Research Associate - III?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate - III post at NIT Delhi involves an Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for NIT Delhi Research Associate - III recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the NIT Delhi Research Associate - III recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for the Research Associate - III post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Research Associate - III position is Delhi, specifically at the National Institute of Technology Delhi campus. It is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of NIT Delhi?
faq.answer: The official website for the National Institute of Technology Delhi is www.nitdelhi.ac.in. Candidates can visit this site for more information and updates regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for the NIT Delhi Research Associate - III recruitment is NITD/MEFCCP/2026/04. This number helps in identifying the specific notification.
